text: Your 401(k) is still maxed past Coast FI while the launch window waits. Some of that could fund the launch instead.
Extra payments are going to low-rate debt before big e is full. The cushion comes first; the debt can wait at its minimum.

Cash is sitting above big e and your sinking funds. That extra could be invested.
